program_summary.description: Builds an analysis-ready establishment file for a single reference period by merging the control file onto collected microdata, keeping establishments above a minimum employment threshold, and computing a final weight per 100 employees.

macro_reference.name: est_prep
macro_reference.purpose: Sorts and merges the control file D2 onto raw microdata D1, applies the employment-level retention threshold, derives the normalized final weight, and writes WORK.O1 for reference period `p`.

variable_dictionary.name: ESTID
variable_dictionary.label: Establishment identifier
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: ST
variable_dictionary.label: State FIPS code
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: PER
variable_dictionary.label: Reference period YYYYMM
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through from the input file when populated; if blank, backfilled from the &p macro variable at call time.

variable_dictionary.name: JO
variable_dictionary.label: Job openings count
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: WGTF
variable_dictionary.label: Final sampling weight
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: RSPF
variable_dictionary.label: Response status flag (R/N/P)
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: EMPL
variable_dictionary.label: Total employment level
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: HIR
variable_dictionary.label: Total hires
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: WGTFR
variable_dictionary.label: Final sampling weight per 100 employees
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed as round(100*WGTF/EMPL, 0.01) when EMPL > 0, else set to missing.
